# INV-FX-SPENDS-CREDIT, 100.00 USD posted on 2026-03-01 at the rates file's
# rate for that day, settled by C-FX's whole 100.00 USD credit, which came in
# under a CAD transaction from the CAD bank at 1.37 CAD/USD (137.00 CAD). The
# `Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD` line states where the difference between the
# two goes. TXN_GUID and SPLIT_GUID are the credit's transaction and split.
#
# Imported into the book the credit test's `_a_cad_paid_credit` makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_credit_spent_at_another_cost_realizes_the_difference.py.
invoice "INV-FX-SPENDS-CREDIT"
	customer_id: "C-FX"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "More consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-04-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-FX-SPENDS-CREDIT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 100.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-02-25
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
